pages.text:
Citely Integration Test Document
Revenue increased by 24% this year, driven primarily by expansion within enterprise accounts. Enterprise customers represented 62% of total revenue.
Operating cash flow was 8.4 million dollars, compared with 6.1 million dollars in the previous year. Improved collections supported the increase.
The principal planning risks are slower enterprise purchase cycles and increased infrastructure costs.
Net revenue retention reached 118%, reflecting deeper adoption and sustained customer engagement.

question: What drove revenue growth?
answer: Revenue growth was driven primarily by expansion within enterprise accounts [Source: Citely-Test-Report.docx | Page: 1]. The company also saw net revenue retention of 118%, reflecting deeper adoption and sustained customer engagement [Source: Citely-Test-Report.docx | Page: 1].
